caption:
A doodle can become a playable game. Here’s the starter prompt 👇

Attach your character sketch to an AI coding tool and paste:

“Build a simple mobile-friendly browser game using this frog drawing as the character reference. Put the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in one runnable index.html file. The frog runs automatically. A tap or Space key makes it jump; rocks end the run if hit. Add collectible stars worth 10 points each, a visible score that updates immediately, a game-over screen, and a Play Again button that resets the score and starts a new run. Keep the controls simple. Tell me how to save and open the file in a browser.”

Then test three things yourself: Does jumping clear a rock? Does a star change 000 to 010? Does Play Again reset the run? If one fails, describe the bug and ask AI to fix that specific behavior.

Save this to try later. Follow @buildwith_pankaj for practical AI builds.
